verdict.rationale: Render lets you define and version your whole architecture in a single Blueprint YAML file, validate it with the CLI, review each change in an ephemeral preview, and deploy from git on every push. Its docs also list Rollbacks, and a community user praises keeping infra-as-code under version control. Workflow tasks are defined in code through the TypeScript and Python SDKs, so they can presumably be versioned in git, but nothing shows that review or rollback applies specifically to automations or workflow runs. Missing for 10: explicit versioning and rollback of workflows/automations, detail on what the Rollbacks feature actually does beyond a docs heading, and hands-on corroboration of rollback behavior.
